title: Prawn and pea rice
summary: Prawn and pea rice is a british dinner built around raw king prawns and frozen peas, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Prawn and pea rice. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add raw king prawns and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and frozen peas.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until basmati rice is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Prawn and pea rice before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Prawn and pea rice.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
